data.short_meaning: Ansh - Breath, soul, essence; I - Inner self
data.long_meaning: Anshi means 'inner soul', 'essence of life', or 'breath of life'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ansh' which means 'breath, soul, or essence' and 'I' which means 'inner self'. In Hinduism, the soul is considered to be the inner self that transcends the physical body and is the true essence of a person. The name Anshi carries the meaning “Ansh - Breath, soul, essence; I - Inner self” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anshi usually hope their child will grow to embody ansh - breath, soul, essence; i - inner self and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection between the inner self and the divine.
